name: How long does commercial water damage restoration typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does commercial water damage restoration typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of commercial water damage restoration varies significantly based on the severity of the damage, the type of water involved (e.g., clean, grey, black water), and the size of the affected area. Minor issues might be resolved in a few days, while extensive damage requiring structural repairs and reconstruction could take several weeks or even months. A professional assessment provides a more accurate timeline after initial inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration time varies greatly, from a few days for minor issues to several weeks or months for extensive damage, depending on severity and scope.
